comparison.objective: Clean an SC fiber ferrule with a prescribed tape stroke, then insert and latch it into an adapter.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-controlled cleaning stroke followed by precision connector insertion and latching versus bulk material separation.
comparison.success_condition: Valid ≥21 mm one-way clean precedes insertion; ferrule must remain uncontaminated and connector latched/released.
comparison.reason: Tests surface preparation and precision optical connection.
